sections.Profile:
The "Flag-Ship" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1957, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Boats, Two player, Women, Wood Rail, Sailing, Ocean, Original Theme
